Scheme guidelines and output framework for the financing facility

records.sourceAnchor: Eligible entities, project purpose and financing facility
observations: The official AIF material describes a Central Sector financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
The official SOP describes 3% annual interest subvention and credit-guarantee support up to ₹2 crore on qualifying loans through lending institutions; this is loan-linked support, not a direct grant.
The official scheme material identifies lender-mediated subsidy adjustment and requires the eligible project and entity route to be checked before treating support as available.
Official AIF material records location/LGD-code, project-count, project-type, contribution, repayment and scheme-period conditions that must remain visible in the fine print.
reviewFollowUps: Reconcile the cited guideline with the latest official amendment or operational circular before publication.
Verify each entity type, eligible project category, project-count rule, separate-location/LGD requirement and the boundary for standalone secondary processing.
Verify lender, State/PMU, guarantee, promoter-contribution, moratorium, disbursement and monitoring conditions from the complete current guideline.
Confirm that the official portal and lender route are operational and record the current application/window state rather than assuming a rolling route.
